children.name: Evidence
children.value: The blocks hold a new config block, which libwavpack has written since 5.0; libwavpack reports encoder version 5 for a file with one

findings.message: The DSD block at 0x8E is one libwavpack refuses: its stored mode holds 37 bytes of audio, but the block counts 8192 samples of 2 channels, which take exactly 16384 bytes.
